description: This Dart source file defines the `ReportsScreen` widget for a Flutter application. The widget displays daily and weekly attendance summaries with date pickers and fetch buttons. It references a `ReportProvider` for data fetching and uses various UI components for presentation.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays daily and weekly attendance summaries with date pickers and refresh buttons, fetching data via `ReportProvider`.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the `ReportsScreen` widget.

methods.name: _mondayOf
methods.description: Calculates the date of the Monday for the week of the given date.

methods.name: _fetchDaily
methods.description: Fetches the daily report data for the selected date.

methods.name: _fetchWeekly
methods.description: Fetches the weekly report data starting from the selected week start date.

methods.name: _pickDay
methods.description: Opens a date picker dialog for selecting a specific day.

methods.name: _pickWeek
methods.description: Opens a date picker dialog for selecting a date to set the start of the week.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to a string key formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
